children: The Reserve Bank of Australia's Index of Commodity Prices rose 15.5% year-on-year in August 2026, easing from an upwardly revised 17.2% gain in the previous month.
The advance was driven by higher prices across most commodities, except iron ore and alumina.
In Australian dollar terms, the index climbed 5.8% year-on-year in August. On a monthly basis, commodity prices increased 1.2% in August in SDR terms, reversing a 0.5% decline in the preceding month.
The non-rural and base metals subindices posted gains, while the rural subindex decreased.

title: Australian Commodity Prices Rise at Softer Pace
